purpose: Teach: 物産/書体/めずらしい/自然体/手際/フィッシング/題する/未読

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、地域、絶対、物産、絶対、を、絶対、扱ったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When we started out, Dad was dead serious about sourcing local products. That was his real commitment.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate. Sits with weight on each phrase. Quiet voice, but commanding — not loud. Long pause between thoughts. The cadence of someone who doesn't repeat himself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、看板の、絶対、書体、絶対、伝統、絶対、守ってまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. Ever since my father's time, we've kept the shop's typeface and traditions exactly as they were. That's something I'm deeply grateful for.
lines.style: Formal respectful bow in the voice. Steady, earnest. Lands hard on commitments — not rushed. Breath under the gratitude, not performance of it. Eyes down slightly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんは、本気で、絶対、めずらしい、絶対、商品、絶対、扱うのが、絶対、得意だったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father had a gift for finding rare products — things other people wouldn't think to stock. He was brilliant at it.
lines.style: Softer now, nostalgic but grounded. Slower pace. Lets the memory settle in his voice. No rush to move forward. A small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの、本気で、絶対、自然体、絶対、なお人柄、絶対、社員、絶対、お慕いしておりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The staff loved him for that — the way he was so natural, so genuinely himself. They really respected him.
lines.style: Warm admission. Still formal, but affection breaks through. Voice softens on 'loved.' Not gushing — sincere. A quiet brightness in his tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、商談の、絶対、手際、絶対、抜群だったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father was extraordinary at handling business conversations. The way he moved through a deal — it was flawless.
lines.style: Direct admiration. Sits forward slightly in the voice. Cleaner pace — not slow, but deliberate. Precision in each word, matching the precision he's describing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、フィッシング、絶対、と、絶対、いう、絶対、用語、絶対、なかったですよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Back when your father ran things, we didn't even have to worry about things like phishing scams. Simpler times.
lines.style: Dry, almost wry glint of humor. Not mocking — affectionate. A slight uptick in pace, like catching an irony together. Eyes meet briefly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、社訓を、絶対、題する、絶対、額、絶対、家に、絶対、飾っていたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father kept a framed copy of the company creed hanging in his home. It meant everything to him.
lines.style: Distant, almost tender. Voice thins slightly — the memory is precious. Trails off gently at the end. Hands might gesture — small, reverent.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代の、本気で、絶対、未読、絶対、手紙、絶対、ばあさんが、絶対、大切に、絶対、保管しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Your father left behind letters your mother still keeps carefully. They remain unread, but treasured. She guards them like they're sacred.
lines.style: Closing statement — slower, more deliberate. Respect deepening. Voice lowers slightly. Ends with quiet finality. A held pause at the end, letting the weight settle.
